source.evidenceLevel: canonical schema, generated Rust/TypeScript/OpenAPI and executable schema checks

decisionBoundary.controller: 唯一命令入口；校验身份、租约/围栏、期望修订和状态转换；持久化 WorkContract/WorkItem/WorkRun 及完成门；只有 Controller 产生完成、重试或人工门禁决定。
decisionBoundary.worker: 只接受 Controller 派发的 WorkRun；在绑定的 WorkerSession、WorkspaceBinding 和 Candidate 上执行；只上报带完整执行身份的事实，不写 WorkItem 完成状态。
decisionBoundary.verifier: 只读取指定 Snapshot 的受保护代码和允许的可写执行目录；按 VerificationPlan 上报命令、测试和结果事实；不能修改产品源代码或直接写权威 Verdict。Controller 校验并持久化 Evidence、VerifierResult 和 Verdict。
decisionBoundary.human: 只作为 Attention 的授权端点，通过 Controller 命令确认、驳回或补充事实，不是第四执行引擎。
decisionBoundary.planner: 降为 Worker 内部生成步骤，不再成为顶层持久化阶段或完成权威。

WorkContract.purpose: 不可变的目标、约束、验收规则和修订链；由 Controller 创建并修订。WorkContract 不持有可变 currentCandidate/currentVerdict，也不直接拥有完成状态。

WorkItem.purpose: 合同中的一个可调度工作单元；完成状态归 WorkItem/运行投影，由 Controller 派生，不由 Worker 直接写。

WorkRun.purpose: 一次派发和执行尝试；调度只依据 WorkItem 图和 WorkRun 状态。
WorkRun.executionBinding: exactly one execution_registry Attempt per WorkRun: executionJobId, attempt, workerId, workerInstanceId, workerSessionId, leaseId, fencingToken; productSessionId/codexThreadId when attached
WorkRun.writeAuthority: Controller creates/binds; Worker reports facts; Controller settles
WorkRun.cardinality: one WorkItem -> many WorkRun; one WorkRun -> exactly one Attempt/lease binding; one WorkRun -> at most one accepted Candidate; rejected candidate observations are facts, not additional accepted candidates

Candidate.purpose: Worker 在一个 WorkRun 的唯一 execution_registry Attempt 中产生的、绑定 WorkContract revision 的冻结代码结果；每个 WorkRun 最多一个被接受 Candidate。不同 WorkRun 即使复用同一 commit，也分别绑定自己的验证身份。
Candidate.writeAuthority: Controller seals Candidate product identity from Worker execution facts
Candidate.identity: candidateId + producer WorkRun; candidateDigest is a separate consistency check

VerificationPlan.purpose: 对 Candidate、Contract revision 和 acceptance criteria 的只读验证声明；固定 criterionIds、commands、permissionProfile 和 workRun 绑定。

Evidence.purpose: Verifier/Worker 上报并由 Controller 根据当前 Candidate、计划、criterion 和完整 fenced execution identity 重建的事实引用。
Evidence.identity: evidenceId + sourceEventId + candidateId + snapshotId + producer execution identity

Verdict.purpose: Controller 根据已接受 Evidence 和计划计算出的结果；Verifier 可提供结果事实，但只有 Controller 能落地权威 Verdict 或 WorkItem 完成门。
Verdict.identity: verdictId + workItemId + candidateId + snapshotId + candidateDigest + verdictRevision

Snapshot.purpose: Controller 校验冻结回执后创建的不可变代码身份；先与验证会话和派发记录一并持久化，再启动验证。

VerificationSession.purpose: 运行时注入的验证会话，固定 Snapshot、Candidate、WorkRun、attempt 和四层会话身份。

VerifierResult.purpose: 根据已接受的验证证据计算的单角色结果，与 Verdict 在同一事务中保存。

relationRules: WorkContract owns WorkItem; WorkItem owns WorkRun and Candidate history. Contract scope is personal/repository-neutral; it does not require organizationId.

One WorkItem has many WorkRun records. Each WorkRun binds exactly one execution_registry Attempt/lease/fencing identity and accepts at most one Candidate. Separate WorkRun records may reuse the same commit, but their verification bindings remain independent.
VerificationPlan must name the exact WorkContract revision, WorkItem revision, Candidate digest and required verifier roles.
Evidence is accepted only when its producer identity, lease/fencing token, WorkRun, Candidate digest and source sequence match the current plan.
Verdict references the exact accepted Evidence set and Candidate digest; a later Candidate or contract revision invalidates the old completion claim.
Every execution identity and relation uses the canonical WorkItem and WorkRun model; no alternate read, write, or migration path exists.

Snapshot and VerificationSession bind CandidateId before execution. Evidence, VerifierResult and Verdict resolve to that same SnapshotId. Repeated freeze requests and new verification attempts reuse the immutable Snapshot; changed protected input creates a new Candidate and Snapshot.

facts: WorkItem and WorkRun commands, queries, and projections
Worker execution transport and fenced identity
Snapshot freeze request, freeze receipt and verification dispatch
canonical schema to generated Rust/TypeScript/OpenAPI chain

schema.requiredNullable: Required nullable properties remain required in JSON and Rust deserialization.
schema.validationBoundary: JSON Schema checks shapes, IDs and bounded fields. Cross-object equality and write authority are enforced by the Controller; a schema-valid JSON object is not a trusted runtime fact.

implementationBoundary: E00 defines and generates the shared object relationships; production scheduling and authority validation consume this one current model. The first alpha starts from the current database format and has no prior-format migration path.
